long_biography.plain_text:
Leaving high school at 15 to support his family, Larry Elvin Jodsaas later earned a GED while serving as a U.S. Navy submarine electrician. He completed an electrical-engineering degree at the University of North Dakota and joined Control Data, progressing from engineering work to senior corporate leadership.

Jodsaas and Gregory Peterson acquired Control Data's VTC semiconductor division in 1990. Under their leadership it captured a leading share of the preamplifier microchip market. A later transaction separated its technology business from the manufacturing operation that became PolarFab. After retiring, Jodsaas endowed engineering leadership and science facilities at colleges in North Dakota and Minnesota.
